tools.name: review_times
tools.description: How long AI app, connector and plugin stores take to review submissions. Omit store for all stores. Returns typical wait (median days to decision), counts, pace and how review works.

tools.name: report_submission
tools.description: Add the user's own submission to a store so others can see real wait times. Only call with the user's permission and for a real submission. The private link to update the report later is emailed to the address given, never returned in the conversation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "report_submission" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Add the user's own submission to a store so others can see real wait times. Only call with the user's permission and for a real submission. Returns a token for updating it later." → after: "Add the user's own submission to a store so others can see real wait times. Only call with the user's permission and for a real submission. The private link to update the report later is emailed to the address given, never returned in the conversation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "update_submission" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
